dz: 俄国和奥斯曼帝国签订的"雅西条约"已经签订,结束了1787–92年的鲁索-土耳其战争.

dz: 康涅狄格州成为第五个批准美国宪法的州。
de: Connecticut becomes the fifth state to ratify the United States Constitution.

t: 菲律宾国内已知的黑色拿撒勒人形象从现在的里扎尔公园转移到了奎阿波教堂小巴西里卡的现今的圣所. …
te: The nationally known image of the Black Nazarene in the Philippines is transferred from what is now Rizal Park to its p…
dz: 菲律宾国内已知的黑色拿撒勒人形象从现在的里扎尔公园转移到了奎阿波教堂小巴西里卡的现今的圣所. 每年通过在马尼拉街头的 " 转帐 " 活动来纪念这一活动,有数百万信徒参加.
de: The nationally known image of the Black Nazarene in the Philippines is transferred from what is now Rizal Park to its present shrine in the minor basilica of Quiapo Church. This is annually commemorated through its Traslación (solemn transfer) in the streets of Manila and is attended by millions of devotees.

dz: 艾哈迈德·沙阿·杜拉尼在巴拉里加特战役中击败了马拉塔斯人.

te: The first of two earthquakes destroys parts of Sicily and Malta. After the second quake on 11 January, the death toll i…
dz: 西西里岛地震：两次地震中的第一次摧毁了西西里岛和马耳他的部分地区。 1 月 11 日第二次地震后，估计死亡人数为 60,000 至 100,000 人。
de: Sicily earthquake: The first of two earthquakes destroys parts of Sicily and Malta. After the second quake on 11 January, the death toll is estimated at between 60,000 and 100,000 people.

dz: "圣女贞德"的审判始于鲁昂.

te: The Jewish population of Basel, believed by the residents to be the cause of the ongoing Black Death, is rounded up and…
dz: 被居民们认为是持续"黑死病"原因的巴塞尔犹太人被围捕并被焚毁.
de: The Jewish population of Basel, believed by the residents to be the cause of the ongoing Black Death, is rounded up and incinerated.

t: 侵扰晋王朝围攻并麻城(今中国宋朝首都开平)的儒林士兵,并绑架了宋国秦宗公等,结束了北宋时期.
te: Invading Jurchen soldiers from the Jin dynasty besiege and sack Bianjing (Kaifeng), the capital of the Song dynasty of …
dz: 晋-宋战争:侵扰晋王朝围攻并麻城(今中国宋朝首都开平)的儒林士兵,并绑架了宋国秦宗公等,结束了北宋时期.
de: Jin–Song Wars: Invading Jurchen soldiers from the Jin dynasty besiege and sack Bianjing (Kaifeng), the capital of the Song dynasty of China, and abduct Emperor Qinzong of Song and others, ending the Northern Song period.

dz: 丁香地震 中国死亡人数约32300人.
de: An earthquake in Dingxiang, China kills an estimated 32,300.

te: King Erwig of the Visigoths initiates a council in which he implements diverse measures against the Jews in Spain.
dz: 第十二届托莱多理事会:维西哥斯国王埃尔维希发起一个理事会,他在其中对西班牙的犹太人实施多种措施.
de: Twelfth Council of Toledo: King Erwig of the Visigoths initiates a council in which he implements diverse measures against the Jews in Spain.

t: 东罗马皇太后维丽娜在君士坦丁堡煽动骚乱，并劝说女婿芝诺皇帝逃离。然而，拜占庭元老院拥戴巴西利斯…
te: Verina, the Eastern Roman dowager Empress, instigates a riot in Constantinople and persuades emperor Zeno, her son-in-l…
dz: 东罗马皇太后维丽娜在君士坦丁堡煽动骚乱，并劝说女婿芝诺皇帝逃离。然而，拜占庭元老院拥戴巴西利斯库斯为皇帝，而不是她的情人帕特里修斯。
de: Verina, the Eastern Roman dowager Empress, instigates a riot in Constantinople and persuades emperor Zeno, her son-in-law, to flee. The Byzantine senate, however, acclaims Basiliscus as emperor and not her lover Patricius.

t: 艾莉娅·尤多西亚被正式加冕为东罗马帝国的皇后.
te: Aelia Eudoxia is officially crowned empress of the Eastern Roman Empire.
dz: 艾莉娅·尤多西亚被正式加冕为东罗马帝国的皇后.
de: Aelia Eudoxia is officially crowned empress of the Eastern Roman Empire.
